manual.scaffolding_and_ladders.line2: {0}Scaffolding is a versatile arrangement of metal rods that can be used in construction.{1}
manual.scaffolding_and_ladders.line3: Scaffolding can also be climbed like ladders along its sides.{0}
manual.scaffolding_and_ladders.line4: {0}Often, factories and machines have vertical drops that need to be traversed.{1}
manual.scaffolding_and_ladders.line5: Metal ladders provide a fireproof method, and can be covered in scaffolding to prevent accidental egress.{0}
manual.scaffolding_and_ladders.line6: Metal ladders can be opened with the Engineer's Hammer by sneaking and rightclicking the ladder.
